# Outputs

<!-- Generated by scripts/skill_outputs.py from outputs.yaml: do not edit by hand. -->

## Required outputs

| Output | Form | Recipient | Complete when |
|---|---|---|---|
| standardization-review | `assets/standardization-review.md`, filled as the work happens, one per use case | `dept-decision-rights`, `bc-build` | Template placement, library check, cluster baseline and delta, and the CSP-readiness verdict are all filled, so neither receiver has to re-ask |
| capability-and-process-group-placement | Section 1 of the review | `dept-decision-rights` | The use case hangs off an existing capability and process group; None was created for one plant |
| cluster-tag-baseline-and-plant-deltas | Section 3 of the review | `bc-build`, plant team | One classifier-assigned tag (C01-C12, never hand-edited); Standard definition, KPI set and checklist pulled as baseline; Only the plant's own deltas recorded |
| csp-readiness-verdict | Section 4 of the review, only for a rollout candidate | `dept-decision-rights`, CSP decision outside OD | Methods and actions are written down with evidence it works at its first plant; A blank or `No` is stated as readiness, not as rejection of the use case |

## Checks

| Output | Check | Sign-off |
|---|---|---|
| standardization-review | structure of `assets/standardization-review.md` | OD lead |
| capability-and-process-group-placement | manual | OD lead |
| cluster-tag-baseline-and-plant-deltas | manual | plant team |
| csp-readiness-verdict | manual | CSP decision outside OD |

## Handoff

- **Receives from:** `funnel-workshop`, `ops-event-model`, `bc-portfolio`, `bc-build`
- **Next:** Lane 2 step 26 (implement and graduate, with deploy-handover and catalog-usecase).: `deploy-handover`, `catalog-usecase`
- **Next:** The review goes to dept-decision-rights for the rollout gate and into the business case of bc-build.: `dept-decision-rights`, `bc-build`
- **Stops here when:** the library already holds a proven entry for the same capability (take it instead of specifying), or the only evidence of standardization is that templates exist
- **Stops here when:** Count adoption and utilization, with the read date, not templates
- **Stops here when:** do not treat a No as a rejection
